title: Wait! I Have Vuln!
description:
[b]Only the players who want to see it need the mod. The host does not.[/b] It is client-side and does not affect gameplay, so friends without the mod can still play with you.

[h2]What you see[/h2]
During a co-op combat:
[list]
[*]The Vulnerable icon appears next to a player in the top-left player list while they have a card that applies Vulnerable in hand. Your own row is included.
[*]A speech bubble pops up over their character for four seconds, in their character's colour, when their icon turns on while an enemy still lacks Vulnerable. The first one of each combat says "Wait! I have vuln!"; later ones vary, and some name you.
[*]When you hover an Attack while a teammate holds a supported card they can play right now, a thought cloud with the Vulnerable icon appears beside the card.
[*]Play an Attack anyway, and that teammate reacts, a little angrier each time that turn.
[/list]
The icon only shows that the card is in hand; the cloud and the reactions skip a teammate who cannot play it right now.

Want it quieter or bigger? Before you start or continue a run, open Settings > Mod Settings from the main menu and select Wait! I Have Vuln! to turn every bubble off and keep only the icon, turn off the card reminder, keep the bubbles on one fixed line, hide everything on your own row, or set the icon size from 50% to 150%. Use the mouse there; the keyboard cannot reach these settings. Your choices are kept for next time.

[b]Supported cards:[/b] Assassinate, Bash, Beam Cell, Break, Comet, Dominate, Expose, Falling Star, Fear, Gamma Blast, High Five, Know Thy Place, Meteor Shower, Putrefy, Shockwave, Squash, Taunt, Thunderclap, Tremble, Uppercut.

[h2]Good to know[/h2]
[list]
[*]Each player sees the icons and bubbles on their own screen only.
[*]Single-player looks the same as without the mod, unless you turn on Solo mode [noparse][dev][/noparse] in the settings: a testing aid that shows your own row in single-player runs from your next run, and turns off when the game restarts.
[*]After a disconnect, a player's icon keeps its last state until the mod can see their hand again.
[*]The bubble text is always English.
[*]Not tested yet: the card reminder and the reactions with real teammates (tested in solo mode only), hosting with the mod, reconnecting in the middle of a combat, using the settings with a controller, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck.
[*]Needs game version 0.107.1 or newer.
[/list]

[h2]Where did my saves go?[/h2]
With mods on, the game uses separate modded save profiles, so your unlocks look gone the first time. Your normal saves are untouched. To copy your normal progress into the modded profile, follow the [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/blob/main/docs/modded-saves.md]save guide[/url].

[h2]Support[/h2]
Report problems in the Bug reports discussion here or on [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/issues]GitHub[/url]. Please include the lines containing [noparse][WaitIHaveVuln][/noparse] from %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\logs\godot.log.

[h2]Source[/h2]
Code, guide, and changelog: [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln]github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln[/url]
